prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final production bitmap logo for the header of a fictional 1993 emergency-management computer program. Create an ORIGINAL polished EMMA CAMP SYSTEM identity. Wide horizontal lockup, about 3.3 to 1, on a perfectly uniform solid PURE BLACK (#000000) background. Pure solid WHITE ink only; absolutely NO transparency, no colour, no glow, no gradient, no grey texture. On the left a simple confident geometric emblem: a small shelter roof above a central radio mast with one balanced pair of signal arcs, contained in an open squared shield. It should read as shelter, community and radio communication at thumbnail size; use a few substantial continuous strokes and generous open negative spaces, no intricate details. On the right exact large text "EMMA" in a clean bold broad squared 1990s workstation typeface, carefully balanced custom letter spacing, easily readable letters with open counters, no stencil gaps. Directly below it exact smaller text "CAMP SYSTEM" in spaced uppercase, strong and readable. The two text rows together match the emblem height. Generous black outer margins around the complete mark. This is a sober professional Kentucky civil-defence software logo from 1993, with character and excellent small-size readability. Flat crisp digital artwork. NO tiny third line, NO Kentucky/year text, NO trademark symbol, NO distressed effects, NO wear, NO shadows, NO noisy pixels, NO monitor, NO frame, NO additional text. It will be keyed and tinted green, sand, aquamarine or purple in the actual game. Keep the emblem compact so the EMMA wordmark dominates.
